title: Add Pollinations App to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pollinations App](https://sohaib7838.github.io/pollinations-app) to image
- A simple web app that lets users connect their Pollinations account and generate AI images using their own Pollen.

Fixes #13892

gist.headline: A fresh image garden
gist.blurb: Pollinations App has joined the image garden. Connect an account, bring your own Pollen, and turn prompts into pixels without wandering off the path.
gist.summary: Added Pollinations App to the image app directory, giving users a simple web app for connecting their Pollinations account and generating AI images with their own Pollen.
gist.impact: People browsing Pollinations image apps can now discover a straightforward account-connected image generator that spends Pollen from their own wallet.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli helping a friendly maker use a cozy little image-generation workstation: a retro browser window shows a simple prompt box, an account connection badge, a Pollen jar, and freshly generated pixel landscape cards growing like flowers. The scene represents a discoverable community-built app that turns a user's own Pollen into images.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden workshop where Polli, the cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown stripes, black oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, light blue translucent wings, and a tiny artist beret, helps at a retro computer showing a simple image prompt box, a connected-account badge, and a small jar of Pollen; generated pixel-art picture cards bloom from flower pots beside it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, code-plants and tiny flowers, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle pixel-font text: "MAKE IMAGES". Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
